INSERT INTO credit_registrations (
    id,
    course_module_completion_id,
    user_id,
    course_id,
    course_module_id,
    course_instance_id,
    external_completion_id,
    external_credit_target_id,
    external_credit_target_code_id,
    attempt_number
  )
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    $7,
    $8,
    (
      SELECT external_credit_target_code_id
      FROM external_completions
      WHERE id = $7
    ),
    $9
  )
